prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, redesign] Live Desktop Arrival Stage Layout: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live companion render previews and animated generation updates while the desktop pet builds in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_arrival_preview", "style": "large"}, {"role": "wait_status", "type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
1: [home, wait_info] Background Desktop Readiness Notification: Add desktop system notifications and estimated completion timers to the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the app during generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "You can minimize this window. We'll notify you when your pet arrives on your desktop."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Controls & Docking Stage: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing quick toggle controls and system tray docking tips.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Use the system tray icon anytime to summon, hide, or interact with your new companion.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:desktop_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "home_welcome", "type": "checklist", "style": "rounded"}]}}}
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Visibility & Tray Hint: Add an explicit hint and callout component on the finish screen explaining how to locate and show the pet if it spawns behind desktop windows.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Can't see your pet? Check your taskbar or system tray icon to bring your pet to the front anytime.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Taskbar Tip", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Grid View Path Selection Stage: Overhaul the path selection screen into a balanced grid layout showcasing path benefits side-by-side with visual companion badges.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Select Your Companion Journey", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
5: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Friend Selection Stage: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a two-column layout displaying high-resolution companion previews alongside pet personality choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:friend_preview", "style": "large"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful"}]}}}
6: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance: Update headline and body on the photo upload screen to emphasize clear lighting and single-subject framing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload a Clear, Well-Lit Photo", "body": "For best results, pick a bright photo with one subject centered against a simple background.", "hint": "Avoid blurry images or heavy filters for accurate pet creation."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Assembly Progress Timer: Display active progress percentage and an estimated countdown timer on the waiting screen with periodic tip rotations every 15 seconds.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [choose_path, redesign] Centered Story Intro Experience: Rebuild the initial story screen using a centered layout with animated mascot greetings to immediately engage users.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"role": "intro_story", "type": "animation", "asset": "asset:intro_anim", "style": "large"}]}}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Instant Companion Launch Commitment: Add an encouraging completion badge component and explicit launch promise button copy to the path choice screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"button_label": "Adopt & Launch Pet", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Free Companion Included", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

Adds helpful notification and time estimate information to the waiting screen within onboarding limits.
Redesigns the home intro onboarding overlay screen while maintaining pet introduction and tray tips.
Adds visibility tips and callout badge to the home intro screen within allowed onboarding modifications.
Redesigns the path selection screen layout while preserving both path choices.
Redesigns the friend selection layout while maintaining pet choices and preview capabilities.
Updates guidance copy on the photo upload screen without changing functionality or pricing.
Displays progress percentage and time estimates for a real generation wait process.
